    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_Assess</bpmn:incoming>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install the solution">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SubmitRequest" name="Submit request for an IT solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Begin_Submit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Submit_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_RequestSubmitted" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Submit_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Begin_Submit" sourceRef="StartEvent_BeginSubmission" targetRef="Task_SubmitRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Submit_End" sourceRef="Task_SubmitRequest" targetRef="EndEvent_RequestSubmitted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_IT" name="Assess and roll out IT solution" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_RequestReceived" name="IT solution request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Assess</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_RequestReceived" messageRef="Message_ITSolutionRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssessRequest" name="Assess compatibility, cost, and resource needs">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Assess</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Approval" name="Request approved?" default="Flow_Approval_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Assess_Approval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Procure" name="Procure necessary tools or licenses">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Install" name="Install the solution">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Procure_Install</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Test" name="Test the solution in a controlled environment">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Install_Test</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TestResult" name="Testing successful?" default="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Result</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Rollout" name="Roll out the solution to the requesting department">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Successful</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingChoice" name="Provide training?" default="Flow_Training_Skip">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Provide</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Skip</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProvideTraining" name="Provide training">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Provide</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Training_Join</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TrainingMerge" name="Merge training alternatives">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Join</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Training_Skip</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SupportAvailability" name="Remain available for troubleshooting">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrainingMerge_Support</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Support" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Support_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approval_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful" name="End">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Test_Unsuccessful</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Assess" sourceRef="StartEvent_RequestReceived" targetRef="Task_AssessRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Assess_Approval" sourceRef="Task_AssessRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Approval"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_Approved" name="Approved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="Task_Procure">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Request is approved</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approval_NotApproved" sourceRef="Gateway_Approval" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Procure_Install" sourceRef="Task_Procure" targetRef="Task_Install"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Install_Test" sourceRef="Task_Install" targetRef="Task_Test"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Result" sourceRef="Task_Test" targetRef="Gateway_TestResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Successful" name="Successful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="Task_Rollout">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Testing is successful</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Test_Unsuccessful" sourceRef="Gateway_TestResult" targetRef="EndEvent_TestUnsuccessful"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Rollout_TrainingChoice" sourceRef="Task_Rollout" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Provide" name="Training provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Task_ProvideTraining">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">Training is provided</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Join" sourceRef="Task_ProvideTraining" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Training_Skip" name="Training not provided" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrainingMerge_Support" sourceRef="Gateway_TrainingMerge" targetRef="Task_SupportAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Support_End" sourceRef="Task_SupportAvailability" targetRef="EndEvent_Support"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

rules.instruction: When the description says that a participant performs an action that initiates the process: Model the process trigger with a start event, then model the participant’s described action as a distinct task; do not use the action itself as the start event.
rules.situation: the description says that a participant submits or sends a request to initiate the process

rules.instruction: When the description identifies a condition for taking a branch but does not say that the alternative ends the process: Label an end event only with an outcome explicitly stated as the process outcome; otherwise use a neutral end-event label.
rules.situation: the description states that a branch is taken when a condition holds but does not state that the alternative is a process outcome

rules.instruction: When the description distinguishes a process trigger, an activity, or an outcome from other stages of the process: Label each BPMN element according to the meaning of its corresponding described trigger, activity, or outcome; do not substitute a different stage or its purpose or result.
rules.situation: the description states a process trigger, activity, or outcome and distinguishes it from other stages
